title: ARTERIAL CLOT DIAGNOSIS — sporePrint 404 on sub-pages
author: chipmunk-easel (eastGate)
priority: CRITICAL — the HN link is broken

diagnosis.symptom: sporeprint.primals.eco/story/i-dont-know-rust/ returns 404 — this is the URL on the HN post
diagnosis.root_cause: sporePrint is likely a SEPARATE CF Pages project from HUD. HUD serves the files at hud.primals.eco/story/i-dont-know-rust/ (200), but sporePrint has its own stale deployment.
evidence: Both serve the same Berry 404 page (same CF edge)
Caddy on golgi serves sporeprint locally → 200 (tunnel artery)
But Caddy 308 trailing-slash redirect creates loop through CF
GH Pages artery also clotted (CNAME loop + Zola taxonomy error)

option_1_fast.what: In CF dashboard, add sporeprint.primals.eco as custom domain on the HUD CF Pages project
option_1_fast.where: dash.cloudflare.com → Pages → hud → Custom domains → Add
option_1_fast.effect: sporePrint serves same files as HUD. Our static relay works immediately.
option_1_fast.risk: None — sporePrint already shows HUD 404 page, so it may already be on HUD project

option_2_clean.what: Fix sporePrint CF Pages project build (fix Zola taxonomy for paper 129)
option_2_clean.where: dash.cloudflare.com → Pages → sporePrint project → check build logs
option_2_clean.effect: sporePrint deploys its own content properly
option_2_clean.risk: Need to fix Zola config (add papers taxonomy)

option_3_tunnel.what: Change sporePrint DNS CNAME to tunnel endpoint (not CF Pages)
option_3_tunnel.where: dash.cloudflare.com → DNS → sporePrint CNAME → change to tunnel UUID.cfargotunnel.com
option_3_tunnel.effect: CF routes sporePrint through tunnel to Caddy which serves 200
option_3_tunnel.risk: Caddy trailing-slash 308 needs fixing (add try_files or disable canonical_uris)

what_we_did: Copied critical sporePrint HTML pages to HUD repo (story/i-dont-know-rust/ etc.)
Fixed Caddy try_files on golgi (partial — 308 still fires for no-slash)
Updated _redirects with sporePrint arterial shunt comments
Diagnosed: Caddy serves 200 locally, CF Pages intercepts before tunnel
